A letter from my heart

Se se tšwago pelong ya ka

Tap to open

Moratiwa wa ka Hlengiwe,

Ga ke tsebe ka mehla gore ke thome kae go bolela seo ke se kwago. Eupša ge ke go lebelela, ke bona motho yo a fetotšego tlhaloso ya matšatši a ka. Ke leboga botho bja gago, motshego wa gago, kgotlelelo ya gago, le dilo tše nnyane tšeo o sa tsebego gore ke a di bona.

Ke a tseba gore ka nako ye nngwe ke a swarega, gomme ka dinako tše dingwe ke bonagala ke le kgole. Eupša ke nyaka gore o tsebe gore pelo ya ka e dula e le go wena. Ke go rata kudu.

Ke go holofetša, ka thato ya Modimo, gore ke tla phethagatša tshepišo ya ka. Ke nna, Kriste le mosetsana wa ka yo a kgethegilego kgahlanong le lefase.

Ke lebeletše letšatši leo ke tlago go go bitša mogatša wa ka.

In short: I may be preoccupied at times, but I truly love you. With God's will, I will keep my promise. It's me, Christ, and my special lady against the world.

Ka lerato ka moka, Kgoputsho

Thank you, for being you

My promise to you

It's me, Christ, and my special lady against the world.

I know I can be preoccupied at times. But please never doubt how deeply I love you. You are always in my heart, even when I'm busy.

God willing, I will keep my promise to you. And I can't wait to call you mogatša wa ka, my wife.

If you ever forget...

Ge o ka tsoga o lebala...
If you ever forget how much you matter, come back here.

If you ever doubt yourself, remember there is someone who sees your beauty, your strength and your worth.

If you ever feel you are not enough, remember you are deeply appreciated. If life gets heavy, you don't have to carry it alone.

And if you ever wonder whether you are loved... the answer will always be yes.

Moratiwa wa ka...

Thank you for existing. Thank you for being part of my life, for every smile, every conversation, every memory.

I may not always have the perfect words, but I hope this little corner of the internet reminds you of one simple truth:

You are loved. You are appreciated. You are cherished. And you are incredibly special to me.

Ngiyabonga ngekuba khona kwakho, sithandwa sami. Ke a go rata.
